notes: SALARIES IN CHANGE MY PLAN. The editor's dropdown now starts with a Salaries group: the planner's salary and, in partner mode, the partner's. The target is the person's Projection sheet row ('Name . Salary'), which is salary plus other monthly income; the dropdown says 'incl. other income' when there is any. Picking a month fills the projected amount, exactly the sheet's value. ENGINE: new target 'salary' (key p1 or p2) in applyRevisions; the delta goes into incomeDelta, scaled by incomeMul so sabbatical and retirement scenarios cut a revised salary exactly as they cut the base. A revised salary keeps growing at the salary growth rate in that person's own appraisal month (verified: 2,50,000 from Jun 27 becomes 2,70,000 in May 28 with an April appraisal; a September appraisal steps in October), priced by the shared revisionAmountAt. Months with a recorded salary (Step 2 income override or Journal salary) or after a retirement stop take priority and are not revised, the same rule as a close event over an EMI revision; the editor says so for such a month. 0 is honoured (e.g. leaving a job). SHEET: the salary row itself shows the revised amount with the scenario marker, like expenses, EMIs and contributions. The fold is now built before the income rows so salary rows can use it; without a preview the sheet is identical to v2026.11.11.06. PRE-EXISTING ENTRY PROBLEM FIXED, FOUND WHILE TESTING: a pre-filled default could be mangled on entry. On a phone the number pad appends, so tapping 2-5-0-0-0-0 on a box showing 44,949 gave 44949250000 unless C was pressed first. On desktop, the number-to-text switch on focus dropped any selection, so typing could land beside the old number. Now, while a box still shows its untouched default: on the pad the first digit replaces it (an operator first builds on it, so +5000 gives 49,949); on desktop focusing the box selects it. Every other field keeps its existing behaviour. VERIFIED in headless Chromium: 16 salary engine checks (growth timing per appraisal month, partner, 0, recorded-salary month, retirement stop, sabbatical scaling, stacking); 9 salary browser checks (dropdown, default equals the sheet cell, saved, list summary, previewed salary row marked and showing 2,16,000 then 2,50,000 then 2,70,000, no separate row, sheet Total Income equals engine); 8 entry checks on phone and desktop paths; all earlier suites pass; engine with no scenarios identical to v2026.05.13.03; no page errors. NOTE: the Decisions itemisation lists scenario expense rows only, so salary revisions are in the Decisions numbers but not itemised. NOT VERIFIED: the guards sheetVsDash, decisionUsesChain, instrumentCrossPageMismatch and accountDeltaMismatches are not in the HTML file and were not run. NOT BUILT: closed-EMI zero row; settlement on its own line; Edit balances port and Instruments page deletion; Decisions/Scenarios merge.
